name: an empty list item that comes first is an empty paragraph in the list style, as in Pandoc
an empty numbered list item that comes first is an empty paragraph
an empty list item in the middle of a list is kept
an empty numbered list item in the middle of a list is kept
a file that holds only a hyphen is one empty paragraph
a lone marker between paragraphs (a hyphen) is an empty list paragraph
a file that holds only a star is one empty paragraph
a lone marker between paragraphs (a star) is an empty list paragraph
a file that holds only a plus is one empty paragraph
a lone marker between paragraphs (a plus) is an empty list paragraph
a file that holds only a number and a period is one empty paragraph
a lone marker between paragraphs (a number and a period) is an empty list paragraph
a file that holds only a number and a parenthesis is one empty paragraph
a lone marker between paragraphs (a number and a parenthesis) is an empty list paragraph
a div fence straight after a paragraph line is text in Pandoc: the fix is a blank line before it
a reference definition at the start of a block is dropped by Pandoc
a double tilde is an empty subscript that Pandoc drops
